title: The recommendations are specific and unambiguous.

chain_of_thought.step1_locate: Recommendations section under 'Glycemic control targets and monitoring'
step2_evidence: A target HbA1c range of 6.0% -7.0% (if it can be safely achieved) is recommended for patients with a life expectancy greater than 10-15 y and no or mild microvascular complications.
chain_of_thought.step3_reasoning: The evidence explicitly uses 'is recommended' (statement on formation), states the purpose (target HbA1c range of 6.0% -7.0%), and identifies the relevant population (patients with life expectancy >10-15 y and no/mild microvascular complications). This meets all required elements for score range 5-7. Since both purpose and population are explicitly stated, the highest score in the range (7) is assigned.
